build_plan_path: build a workspace-relative markdown plan path from a user instruction string with timestamp and slug
scan_skill_commands: scan the skills directories and return a mapping of slash-command keys to skill metadata
resolve_skill_command_key: resolve a user-typed slash command to its canonical skill command key with hyphen normalization
build_skill_invocation_message: build a formatted system message payload for a slash-command skill invocation with optional user instruction
build_preloaded_skills_prompt: build a combined prompt text from a list of preloaded skill identifiers for session-wide CLI use
